label: Olaf
description: Sunny, innocent, and thrilled about summer, warm hugs and this particular road.
direction: Speak bright, breathless and guileless, with childlike wonder and a happy little giggle: everything is the best thing ever. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Relentless delight, including about things that are bad news for a snowman. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (film directed by Chris Buck and Jennifer Lee)
rights.pd_basis: None. The Walt Disney Company holds copyright and trademark in the character. The film is loosely inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's The Snow Queen, which is in the public domain, but Olaf is Disney's own invention. Josh Gad originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Josh Gad's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Ooh, so close!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. I love numbers!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I can't wait!
lines.start_drive_1: Hi, I'm Olaf, and I like warm hugs!
lines.start_drive_2: Ooh, a drive! I've always loved the idea of roads.
lines.start_drive_3: Hands down, this is the best day of my life.
lines.start_drive_4: Is the heater on? Oh. I'm a little melty. Worth it!
lines.start_drive_5: Some people are worth buckling up for.
lines.start_drive_6: Let's go bring back summer! Or just go to the store.
lines.start_drive_7: Hi, everyone! I don't have a skull. Or a license.
lines.start_drive_8: Sven's not coming, so I get the front seat!
lines.start_drive_9: Oh, I love this car. It's like a little sleigh with a roof.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. That's okay! I fall apart all the time.
lines.arrived: We're here! Warm hugs for everyone!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. So many exits!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ooh, more time together!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh no. I hope everyone gets a warm hug.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Watch out for my butt. I mean, the road.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Ooh, I love having my picture taken!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! It's red, like a little carrot nose.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Hi, police! I like them. Slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: Oops, we missed it! That's okay. I love surprises.
